hooks.text: 在传统肉鸽RPG基础上加入制作、生存与基地建设管理，扩大开放与混乱程度
hooks.excerpt: While retaining the traditional roguelike gameplay, Elin introduces crafting, survival elements, and base building/management, creating an even more open and chaotic experience.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可自由经营人生与聚落，从钓鱼偷窃、音乐农牧到开店旅游和生育都能参与
hooks.excerpt: Live your life, survive, craft, build and manage bases and towns, enjoy housing, fishing, theft, music, farming, livestock breeding, childbirth, setting up shops, tourism, and much more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 无尽随机生成内容与手工固定内容无缝交织，兼顾持续变化与世界设定
hooks.excerpt: A seamless blend of endless randomly generated content and carefully crafted fixed content faithful to the world setting.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: The art style in this game is absolutely gorgeous!
